dedupe_keys.name: portugal sns transparency acute hospital bed capacity by bed type and occupancy rate per hospital monthly since 2013

description: These two datasets give, for every public hospital in Portugal's National Health Service, how many acute beds are in use each month and how full they are. They are published by the Executive Directorate of the SNS on its Transparency portal. The capacity dataset counts beds available and equipped for immediate admission, split into surgical, medical, neutral (not assigned to a specialty) and other beds, from January 2015 to June 2026, with each hospital's region and coordinates. The occupancy dataset gives inpatient days, beds in use and the occupancy rate per hospital, monthly from January 2013. Both are free and available to download from the portal in CSV, JSON, Excel, Parquet and GeoJSON, and through its open API. Caveats: the most recent two months are provisional, only acute beds are covered, and only in hospitals reporting to the SNS. Simulation uses: setting hospital bed capacity and baseline occupancy in surge and evacuation models, mapping exposure of beds to floods, heat or earthquakes, and checking headroom during epidemics. Related records: the SNS emergency department data (data-sns-portugal-emergency-department-attendances) and the Spanish national hospital catalogue (data-spain-catalogo-nacional-hospitales) cover neighbouring aspects.
